title: KODEX — KWARD: DISRUPT
description:
KODEX — KWARD (DISRUPT). disruption early-warning — real-device (592 MAST shots), calibrated ensemble + per-shot OOD gate; advisory, downstream of the KGATE clamp

Benchmark: real-device AUC 0.98 (591 MAST shots), ECE 0.0349; **independent-precursor AUC 0.975** (n=1 Mirnov + P_rad ONLY, label-independent); labels heuristic (Ip-quench)

Part of KODEX, the Kronos Family of Codes — a benchmarked AI/ML fusion surrogate suite with calibrated uncertainty and an abstention gate (predict(x) → (y, uncertainty, in_domain)).
